title: Crüger to Müller, 9 August 1622
author: Peter Crüger
summary: Having read the fourth book of Kepler's *Epitome* more than once, Crüger still cannot understand its proportions of the planetary orbs and bodies, and suspects Kepler of obscuring things on purpose.

notes.on: the fourth book of Kepler's Astronomy
notes.note: Book IV of the *Epitome astronomiae Copernicanae* (1620), on celestial physics.
